newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill three in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill three in Karachi.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot and killed three people in Pakistan's southern port city of Karachi on Wednesday, police said.
They said the gunmen sprayed bullets from a car at a shop and killed a tailor and two passersby in the New Karachi area of the city.
Nobody claimed responsibility for the killings, police said.
The Karachi-based ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM) and its breakaway Haqiqi faction accuse each other of violence.
The MQM speaks for the Urdu-speaking people who migrated from India at Partition in 1947.
